{{Quote|Two years ago, Ri'kan was part of a group helping the Imps on Belsavis. They were good--experienced, skilled, all that. The Republic hired their own team to stop them. Our-- Our sister, Layla, was in charge. There were casualties, for both sides. The Imp mission failed, but Ri'kan escaped. Layla didn't make it.|[[Rass Ordo]]|<ref name="showdown" />}}
During the [[Third Galactic War]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Layla Ordo]] led an '''operation''' under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], to disrupt an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The Republic forces were victorious, but Layla Ordo was killed during the mission.<ref name="showdown" />
